items.source: The TitanEmbeddingBedrockApi provides is lightweight Java client on top of AWS Bedrock Titan Embedding models.

items.source: Provides Bedrock Titan Embedding model. Amazon Titan foundation models (FMs) provide customers with a breadth of high-performing image, multimodal embeddings, and text model choices, via a fully managed API. Amazon Titan models are created by AWS and pretrained on large datasets, making them powerful, general-purpose models built to support a variety of use cases, while also supporting the responsible use of AI. Use them as is or privately customize them with your own data.
items.translation: 提供 Bedrock Titan 嵌入模型。 Amazon Titan 基础模型（FMs）通过完全托管的 API，为客户提供广泛的高性能图像、多模态嵌入和文本模型选择。 Amazon Titan 模型由 AWS 创建，并在大型数据集上进行预训练，使其成为功能强大且通用的模型，旨在支持各种用例，同时促进人工智能的负责任使用。 您可以直接使用这些模型，或使用自有数据对其进行私有化定制。
